title: Robust actor initialization with retries and improved connection diagnostics

requirements.summary: Expose actor initialization errors to the UI and add finite exponential-backoff retries plus user-triggered retry without page reload.
acceptanceCriteria: When backend calls fail during actor creation/initialization, the app does not silently fall through to the generic 'Connection Failed' state without details; the underlying error message is available to the gate.
Actor initialization automatically retries (finite attempts) with backoff before showing the error state.
The 'Retry Connection' action triggers a refetch/retry of actor initialization without requiring window.location.reload().
If retries eventually succeed, the app proceeds to the authenticated flow without requiring the user to re-login.

file_operations.description: Create a new Actor provider + hook (do not modify the immutable useActor/useInternetIdentity hooks) that performs actor initialization with (a) captured error details, (b) finite retries with exponential backoff, and (c) an imperative refetch/retry API. Ensure it preserves the current Internet Identity session (no forced logout) and exposes initialization stage info for UI diagnostics.
Add a small utility to run async operations with finite retries and exponential backoff (including jitter and max delay) and to return the last error for UI display.

Refactor useActorReady to consume the new useBackendActor state (ready/loading/error/refetch), removing the current window.location.reload refetch behavior and exposing the underlying initialization error for the gate UI.

Wire the new actor provider into the authenticated app tree so all downstream data hooks can access the initialized actor without modifying immutable files. Ensure actor initialization is driven by identity changes and the app can recover after transient failures.

requirements.summary: Use the backend health method during initialization to distinguish unreachable backend from other initialization failures and improve user messaging.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a new query method that can be called anonymously and returns quickly without side effects.
Frontend calls the health method as part of the connection/initialization path and uses it to determine whether the canister is reachable.
If the health call succeeds but initialization still fails, the UI indicates this is not a general connectivity outage (i.e., it is a different error).

file_operations.description: In the actor initialization flow, call the existing backend health capability (getStatus) using an anonymous actor to determine reachability before/during authenticated initialization. Store health-check results (success/failure + timestamp/message) alongside initialization errors so the UI can differentiate 'backend unreachable' vs 'reachable but init failed'.

Update the connection/error UI to incorporate the health-check result: if health succeeds but initialization fails, show messaging indicating the canister is reachable and the failure is specific to initialization/authorization. Keep all user-facing text in English.

requirements.summary: Enhance the Connection Failed screen with sanitized error details, offline hint, and three recovery actions including cache-busting hard refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: The error state shows a readable error message derived via the existing error-message utility (or equivalent) rather than only generic text.
If navigator.onLine is false, the UI explicitly tells the user they appear offline.
The error screen provides three distinct recovery actions: Retry (refetch), Logout & Retry (clear II state then refetch), and Hard refresh (cache-busting reload).
All user-facing text on the error screen is English.

file_operations.description: Improve the error-state UI: (1) display a stable English error string using frontend/src/utils/errorMessage.ts, (2) add an explicit offline hint based on navigator.onLine, and (3) replace reload-based retry with a refetch/retry call. Add a third action 'Hard refresh' that performs a cache-busting reload (e.g., by adding a changing query param). Keep 'Logout & Retry' by calling clear() then triggering a refetch.

Add helper(s) to normalize/sanitize initialization errors into stable English strings for the Connection Failed UI (wrapping getErrorMessage and mapping common agent/replica/deploy transient failures to consistent phrasing).
